request: Plan one Saturday in Seabrook for a family of two adults and a 7-year-old. Total $115 excluding hotel. Child needs a lunch break at noon and activities must be step-free.
travel_notes: Aquarium 9-18: adults $22, child $12, step-free. Beach free, step-free boardwalk. Lighthouse $8 adult/$4 child, 90 stairs. Bus family pass $12. Lunch family estimate $28, dinner $35. Aquarium to beach 20 minutes by bus. Breakfast prepaid.
